# opening day

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:openingDay`](gmeow-openingDay.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/openingDay>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/organization`](../../slices/organization.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A day this opening-hours window applies to — a [`gmeow:DayOfWeek`](../classes/gmeow-DayOfWeek.md) value. Non-functional (a window may span several days). Projects to [schema:dayOfWeek.](https://schema.org/dayOfWeek.)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record which day(s) a [`gmeow:OpeningHoursSpecification`](../classes/gmeow-OpeningHoursSpecification.md) window applies to, referencing [`gmeow:DayOfWeek`](../classes/gmeow-DayOfWeek.md) value individuals.

### Avoid when

- Avoid a free-text day name (reference a [`gmeow:DayOfWeek`](../classes/gmeow-DayOfWeek.md) individual) and avoid splitting one window across days with incompatible open/close times — mint a separate window.

### How to use

- Attach one or more [`gmeow:openingDay`](gmeow-openingDay.md) triples to a [`gmeow:OpeningHoursSpecification`](../classes/gmeow-OpeningHoursSpecification.md) referencing [`gmeow:DayOfWeek`](../classes/gmeow-DayOfWeek.md) individuals, alongside [`gmeow:opensAt`](gmeow-opensAt.md) and [`gmeow:closesAt`](gmeow-closesAt.md); projects to [schema:dayOfWeek.](https://schema.org/dayOfWeek.)

### Examples

- ex:weekdayHours [`gmeow:openingDay`](gmeow-openingDay.md) [`gmeow:dayMonday`](../individuals/gmeow-dayMonday.md).
